# Jayce Yap Zi Wen

> Personal portfolio of an AIA Life Planner in Malaysia.

The website explains general protection topics and helps visitors prepare a consultation request.
WhatsApp requests are sent by the visitor and are subject to confirmation by Jayce.
The portrait is an AI illustration, pending the planner's own photograph.
The website is a preview and is currently marked noindex.

## Pages

- [Meet Jayce](/#about): Planning approach and introduction.
- [Your protection](/#protection): Medical protection, critical illness, life protection, and policy reviews.
- [Planning check](/#check-in): Three questions to prepare for a conversation, not a personalised recommendation.
- [The journal](/#journal): Educational notes with AIA Malaysia sources.
- [Request a conversation](/#contact): Prepare and review a WhatsApp enquiry.
